parsed.headline: bursty-rare: increase CPU is supported, memory can be decreased

cpu.explanation: CPU request can be increased from 0.050 cores to 0.109 cores (118% increase). The p95 CPU usage of 0.109 cores is above the current request, supporting an increase. However, a short peak of 0.554 cores (1-minute rate) is more than 2x the candidate request, which could hide bursts.

memory.explanation: Memory request can be decreased from 64Mi to 32Mi (-50%). The candidate request of 5Mi is below the minimum floor of 32Mi, so the floor value is used.

caveats: History covers about 0.4 h of the requested 3.0 h window.
